Evidence 3: Tahrust's Autopsy Report
Description: "Cause of death was blood loss from an abdominal wound delivered by a bladed weapon."

This only confirms the means of death, but doesn't clarify the strength needed.

Evidence 23: Tome of Secrets
"A tome given only to the one who will play the role of Lady Kee'ra in the Purification Rite. ... She is doing a ritual dance, holding a bird-shaped dagger in her right hand..."
